verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a card-issuing product: Visa and Mastercard, physical and virtual cards, spend controls, and funding on authorization instead of pre-funding. None of the evidence names the card program types the story requires: debit, prepaid, commercial credit or consumer credit. Network choice, card form factor and funding mechanics are adjacent features and do not establish breadth of card program types.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform supports the card types my product needs — debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit programs — not just one prepaid rail
